audience: e-shops that take online payments through Comgate

useCases.title: Check the status of a payment
useCases.text: Read a payment by its transaction id: status, amount, currency, method, fee and the payer's contact fields.

useCases.title: Create a payment link for an order
useCases.text: List the payment methods, then create a payment request for an order. Send the payer the returned link. Money moves only when the payer pays.

useCases.title: Cancel a payment the payer did not complete
useCases.text: Read the payment first. Cancel it only while its status is PENDING. A paid payment cannot be cancelled.

useCases.title: Refund part of a paid payment
useCases.text: Read the payment to confirm it is PAID. Refund all or part of it in the smallest currency unit. The money goes back to the payer, and the refund cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Check which bank transfers were paid out on a date
useCases.text: List the bank transfers paid out to the merchant account on one date. Open a transfer to see the payments it contains.
